title: KBC Table C — kbc_karyotype_burden_summary (per tier)
description: One row per (tier, inversion, karyotype class, POD segment). The headline summary. Source: SPEC_KBC.md §3.C; tier column added per §4 Step 4 (the implementation loops over the three damaging-variant tiers and writes rows with a tier discriminator).

tier.description: T1 = high-confidence LoF (manuscript headline); T2 = T1 + validated splice Class A; T3 = T2 + strong missense (exploratory). See SPEC_KBC.md §1.8.

karyotype_class.description: NA samples are dropped before aggregation.

complementation_index.description: AB-only. Null for AA and BB rows. Fraction of damaging genes where A-side and B-side carry different damaging variants.

exposure_delta_vs_AB.description: AA / BB only. Null for AB rows. mean_burden_score(this_class) − mean_burden_score(AB at same segment).

exposure_delta_vs_AB_hom_genes.description: AA / BB only. Null for AB. Same delta on mean_hom_exposed_gene_count.

wilcoxon_p_vs_AB.description: AA / BB only. Null for AB. Mann-Whitney U on hom_exposed_gene_count, this class vs AB, on the NAToRA-pruned subset.

glm_kinship_p_vs_AB.description: AA / BB only. Null for AB. Full-cohort kinship-corrected mixed-model p.

n_genes_arrangement_specific.description: Genes hit by ≥ 1 arrangement-private damaging variant.
